eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Systems and Control (ICSC) aims to provide an international forum for the presentation and discussion of advances in systems theory, modeling, control, optimization, and their emerging applications. The conference welcomes both theoretical developments and practical contributions in the design, analysis, and implementation of control systems across various engineering domains. Topics of interest include linear and nonlinear systems, hybrid and time-delay systems, estimation and identification, observer design, robust and optimal control, intelligent and AI-based control, and applications to renewable energy, robotics, process control, and cyber-physical systems.
